name: lib/formula
description: Dependency-free spreadsheet formula layer. A cell whose text starts with `=` is a formula: cell references (`A1`, `$B$2`), ranges (`A1:B3`), `+ - * /`, parentheses, unary minus, numbers, quoted strings, and the functions SUM, AVERAGE, MIN, MAX, and COUNT (extend them through `functions`). Evaluation is lazy and memoized per evaluator; cycles report `#CYCLE!`, references outside the sheet `#REF!`, unknown names `#NAME?`, bad syntax `#ERROR!`, text in arithmetic `#VALUE!`, and division by zero `#DIV/0!`.
